decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Fire safety statement, unnumbered location plan, EA/32/10/1A, EA/32/10/1B, EA/32/10/1C 
Received: 07/10/2024
unnumbered parking plan
Received: 03/03/2025
Traffic survey, design and access statement 
Received: 29/04/2025].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No external storage/storage of materials, goods, or waste shall take place outside the building or designated display area, in order to maintain a tidy appearance and avoid obstruction.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area and to ensure compliance with transport policies.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the business at the address 'Unit 10 Ground Floor And Part First Floor, Feltham Business Complex Browells Lane, TW13 7LW' described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate commercial use (office or storage space).

Reason: To protect neighbour conditions, the character of the area and road safety
description: Installation of a shutter to the front and erection of a side wall to enclose the front ground floor area to be used as office/storage
site_name: Unit 10 Ground Floor And Part First Floor
